rationale: Era's deep conviction in edge inference and on-device AI aligns naturally with AJ's focus on practical robotics hardware-software co-design—both are building systems where computation happens at the edge rather than in centralized cloud. Era's background in AI infrastructure and open-source composable stacks, combined with her institutional finance experience, could offer valuable perspective on how to scale dexterous robotic systems, while AJ's hands-on expertise in robot learning and hardware integration could ground Era's edge AI vision in real physical-world constraints.
intro_message: Era Qian, meet AJ Chahal — you're both building practical systems at the edge (Era in sovereign on-device AI, AJ in dexterous robot manipulation), and your complementary expertise in infrastructure and hardware-software co-design could spark ideas on scaling embodied AI systems.
